actions.objective: Start /app/alpine.iso in QEMU in the background and expose the guest login prompt on localhost:6665 so telnet can connect and show the login prompt.
required_artifacts: A running QEMU process started from /app/alpine.iso
A host-forwarded TCP listener on 127.0.0.1:6665 connected to the guest login service
required_behaviors: QEMU must remain running in the background after launch
Connecting with telnet to 127.0.0.1:6665 must display the Alpine login prompt
The VM must be booted far enough that the login prompt is ready before finalization
known_invalid_patterns: Only verifying that QEMU starts without confirming the login prompt
Leaving QEMU attached to the foreground
Forwarding the wrong guest port or host port
Stopping QEMU before the prompt is reachable
verification_plan: Inspect workspace for any helper scripts or prior receipts if needed
Launch QEMU detached/backgrounded with hostfwd from 127.0.0.1:6665 to the guest login service
Probe 127.0.0.1:6665 until the login prompt is observed
Keep the VM running after successful probe
finalization_evidence_required: Receipt-backed evidence of the QEMU launch command and backgrounded process
Receipt-backed probe evidence showing the login prompt on 127.0.0.1:6665
notes: Preserve the original request over any derived state conflicts.

items: Inspect visible workspace contents for launch-relevant assets or scripts
Determine the correct QEMU invocation for /app/alpine.iso
Start QEMU in the background with host forwarding to 127.0.0.1:6665
Probe the port until the login prompt appears
Leave the VM running once ready
